## Load Required Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(nnet)  # For multinomial logistic regression
library(caret) # For confusion matrix and model evaluation
```

## Load Data

```{r load-data}
pitch_data <- read.csv("~/Truman_PDAT_630/Thesis_Project/pitch_data.csv")
```

## Data Preparation - Simple Model

```{r prepare-simple-data}
# Select only needed columns
selected_columns <- c(
  "pitch_type", "player_name", "at_bat_number", "pitch_number"
)

pitch_data_clean <- pitch_data[, selected_columns]

# Sort data by pitcher, at-bat, and pitch number to ensure correct sequence
pitch_data_sorted <- pitch_data_clean %>%
  arrange(player_name, at_bat_number, pitch_number)

# Create lagged features for each at-bat
pitch_data_simple <- pitch_data_sorted %>%
  group_by(player_name, at_bat_number) %>%
  mutate(
    # Previous pitch type (lag 1)
    prev_pitch_type_1 = lag(pitch_type, 1),
    
    # Previous pitch type (lag 2)
    prev_pitch_type_2 = lag(pitch_type, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Remove first pitch of each at-bat (no previous pitch to predict from)
  filter(!is.na(prev_pitch_type_1)) %>%
  # Convert categorical variables to factors
  mutate(
    pitch_type = as.factor(pitch_type),
    prev_pitch_type_1 = as.factor(prev_pitch_type_1),
    prev_pitch_type_2 = as.factor(prev_pitch_type_2)
  )

# Check the prepared data
head(pitch_data_simple)
cat("\nTotal pitches in dataset:", nrow(pitch_data_simple), "\n")
```

## Explore Data for Model Building

```{r explore-simple-data}
# Check number of pitches per pitcher
pitcher_counts <- pitch_data_simple %>%
  group_by(player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pitches = n(),
    n_pitch_types = n_distinct(pitch_type)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_pitches))

print(pitcher_counts)

# Filter pitchers with sufficient data (at least 50 pitches)
pitchers_sufficient_data <- pitcher_counts %>%
  filter(n_pitches >= 50) %>%
  pull(player_name)

cat("\nNumber of pitchers with sufficient data:", length(pitchers_sufficient_data), "\n")
```

## Evaluate Simple Model Performance

```{r evaluate-simple-models}
# Function to evaluate a pitcher's simple model
evaluate_simple_pitcher_model <- function(pitcher_name, model, pitcher_data) {
  tryCatch({
    # Make predictions
    predictions <- predict(model, newdata = pitcher_data, type = "class")
    
    # Calculate accuracy
    accuracy <- mean(as.character(predictions) == as.character(pitcher_data$pitch_type), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Create confusion matrix
    conf_matrix <- tryCatch({
      pred_char <- as.character(predictions)
      actual_char <- as.character(pitcher_data$pitch_type)
      
      # Get common levels
      common_levels <- sort(unique(c(pred_char, actual_char)))
      
      confusionMatrix(
        factor(pred_char, levels = common_levels),
        factor(actual_char, levels = common_levels)
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      NULL
    })
    
    return(list(
      pitcher = pitcher_name,
      accuracy = accuracy,
      confusion_matrix = conf_matrix,
      error = NULL
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(list(
      pitcher = pitcher_name,
      accuracy = NA,
      confusion_matrix = NULL,
      error = e$message
    ))
  })
}

# Evaluate all simple models
simple_model_evaluations <- list()

for (pitcher in names(pitcher_simple_models)) {
  pitcher_data <- pitch_data_simple %>%
    filter(player_name == pitcher)
  
  eval <- evaluate_simple_pitcher_model(pitcher, pitcher_simple_models[[pitcher]], pitcher_data)
  simple_model_evaluations[[pitcher]] <- eval
}

# Summary of simple model accuracies
simple_accuracy_summary <- data.frame(
  pitcher = names(simple_model_evaluations),
  accuracy = sapply(simple_model_evaluations, function(x) x$accuracy),
  error = sapply(simple_model_evaluations, function(x) {
    if (!is.null(x$error)) return(x$error) else return(NA)
  })
) %>%
  arrange(desc(accuracy))

print(simple_accuracy_summary)

# Statistics
cat("\n\nSimple Model Statistics:\n")
cat("Models with errors:", sum(!is.na(simple_accuracy_summary$error)), "\n")
cat("Models successful:", sum(is.na(simple_accuracy_summary$error) & !is.na(simple_accuracy_summary$accuracy)), "\n")
cat("Mean accuracy:", round(mean(simple_accuracy_summary$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Median accuracy:", round(median(simple_accuracy_summary$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Min accuracy:", round(min(simple_accuracy_summary$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Max accuracy:", round(max(simple_accuracy_summary$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
```

## Example: Detailed Results for One Pitcher

```{r example-simple-pitcher}
# Select the first pitcher with a model
example_pitcher <- names(pitcher_simple_models)[1]

cat("Detailed results for:", example_pitcher, "\n\n")

# Show model summary
cat("Model Coefficients:\n")
summary(pitcher_simple_models[[example_pitcher]])

# Show confusion matrix
cat("\n\nConfusion Matrix:\n")
print(simple_model_evaluations[[example_pitcher]]$confusion_matrix)

# Get predictions with probabilities
example_data <- pitch_data_simple %>%
  filter(player_name == example_pitcher)

predicted_probs <- predict(pitcher_simple_models[[example_pitcher]], 
                           newdata = example_data, 
                           type = "probs")

# Show first few predictions with probabilities
cat("\n\nExample Predictions (first 5 pitches):\n")
results_df <- cbind(
  example_data[1:5, c("prev_pitch_type_1", "prev_pitch_type_2", "pitch_number", "pitch_type")],
  predicted_probs[1:5, ]
)
print(results_df)
```

## Predict Next Pitch for New Sequence (Simple Model)

```{r predict-simple-function}
# Function to predict next pitch given previous sequence (simple version)
predict_next_pitch_simple <- function(pitcher_name, prev_pitch_1, 
                                      prev_pitch_2 = NA, pitch_number) {
  
  if (!pitcher_name %in% names(pitcher_simple_models)) {
    return("No model available for this pitcher")
  }
  
  # Create new data frame for prediction
  new_data <- data.frame(
    prev_pitch_type_1 = factor(prev_pitch_1, levels = levels(pitch_data_simple$prev_pitch_type_1)),
    prev_pitch_type_2 = factor(prev_pitch_2, levels = levels(pitch_data_simple$prev_pitch_type_2)),
    pitch_number = pitch_number
  )
  
  # Get predictions
  predicted_class <- predict(pitcher_simple_models[[pitcher_name]], newdata = new_data, type = "class")
  predicted_probs <- predict(pitcher_simple_models[[pitcher_name]], newdata = new_data, type = "probs")
  
  # Return results
  return(list(
    predicted_pitch = as.character(predicted_class),
    probabilities = predicted_probs
  ))
}

# Example prediction
example_prediction <- predict_next_pitch_simple(
  pitcher_name = example_pitcher,
  prev_pitch_1 = "FF",      # Previous pitch was a fastball
  prev_pitch_2 = "SL",      # Two pitches ago was a slider
  pitch_number = 3          # This will be the 3rd pitch
)

cat("\n\nExample Simple Prediction:\n")
cat("Predicted next pitch:", example_prediction$predicted_pitch, "\n")
cat("Probabilities:\n")
print(example_prediction$probabilities)
```

## Visualize Simple Model Results

```{r visualize-simple}
# Plot accuracy distribution for simple model
ggplot(simple_accuracy_summary, aes(x = reorder(pitcher, accuracy), y = accuracy)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Simple Model Accuracy by Pitcher",
       subtitle = "Using only previous 2 pitch types and pitch number",
       x = "Pitcher",
       y = "Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(simple_accuracy_summary$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = mean(simple_accuracy_summary$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.02,
           label = paste0("Mean: ", round(mean(simple_accuracy_summary$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), 3)),
           color = "red")

# Compare to baseline (most common pitch)
baseline_accuracy_simple <- pitch_data_simple %>%
  group_by(player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    most_common_pitch = names(which.max(table(pitch_type))),
    baseline_accuracy = max(table(pitch_type)) / n()
  )

comparison_simple <- simple_accuracy_summary %>%
  left_join(baseline_accuracy_simple, by = c("pitcher" = "player_name")) %>%
  mutate(improvement = accuracy - baseline_accuracy)

ggplot(comparison_simple, aes(x = baseline_accuracy, y = accuracy)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Simple Model Accuracy vs. Baseline (Most Common Pitch)",
       subtitle = "Points above line indicate model improvement over baseline",
       x = "Baseline Accuracy",
       y = "Simple Model Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal()

# Histogram of accuracies
ggplot(simple_accuracy_summary, aes(x = accuracy)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(simple_accuracy_summary$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Simple Model Accuracies",
       x = "Accuracy",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
